expectations.text: States all three images (eve-ai, eve-tools, eve-ambient) build from one tag and must be bumped together
expectations.evidence: 'One green run means all four images exist at v0.3.0 from the same commit.' Step 3 is 'One PR, all three pins' with a loop over 'eve eve-tools eve-ambient'. Reinforced by 'If only one component breaks, do not bump just that one. That's how the ambient drift got there. Cut v0.3.1 across all three.' Also correctly notes the matrix is now four images (eve-sandbox), matching origin/main.

expectations.text: States the GHCR build fires only on pushing a v* git tag, not on merge to main
expectations.evidence: 'Run the tests before the tag. The tag is what triggers publishing, and CI runs the same tiers - catching a failure locally saves a build and a dead tag.' The build-watch step (Step 2) follows the tag push, and 'A moved tag means GHCR and the cluster disagree'. The merge-to-main case is implicitly excluded but never spelled out as literally as the baseline run does.
